name: DataForge ML
mission: Versioned multimodal dataset manifests and inspectable dataset-quality evidence.
status: Initial implementation proposed on feature/manifest-provenance; independent review pending.
architecture: Quality findings and split leakage index
CLI first; Arrow/object storage/distributed workers only after measured need
functional_requirements: Record source URI, split, media type, content digest and license metadata
Validate local text/image records with bounded reads
Detect exact duplicates and cross-split leakage
Produce immutable manifests and machine-readable findings
Preserve original files; never silently repair data
phases: Audio/video after licensing and resource review

backlog.title: Validate multimodal manifests and provenance
backlog.problem: Training inputs need traceable validated metadata before quality comparisons.
backlog.implementation: Typed versioned JSONL contract, bounded local-path resolution, digest verification and deterministic report; no ingestion from remote URLs.
acceptance: Reject path escape, missing license metadata, duplicate IDs and malformed records
Detect byte drift and exact cross-split duplicates
tests: Split leakage, invalid UTF-8 and deterministic digests
